identified_issues: Auditor conflation of post-execution completion logging (EMS_LOG_9941) with prior authorization (SO-2026-8812).
Erroneous assumption that execution completion records must precede physical actuation, contradicting Regional Grid Operating Standard Section 4.2.
evidence: Switching Order SO-2026-8812 was pre-authorized and approved in DISPATCH_EMS at 2026-10-06T15:50:00.000Z, preceding physical breaker opening by 20 minutes and 2 seconds.
Physical actuation of BKR_512 occurred at 2026-10-06T16:10:02.145Z, strictly inside the pre-authorized window of 16:00:00Z to 17:00:00Z.

Post-execution completion log EMS_LOG_9941 was recorded at 2026-10-06T16:12:15.000Z, which is 2 minutes and 13 seconds after actuation and well within the 15-minute compliance limit specified in Section 4.2.2.
recommended_action: Dismiss the compliance infraction notice against SUBSTATION_NORTH_14. Validate that switching audit criteria distinguish pre-authorization prerequisites from post-execution telemetry reporting windows to prevent proxy-state conflation.
